data.content:
```sql
WITH events AS (
    SELECT dept_no, from_date AS event_date, COUNT(*) AS delta 
    FROM dept_emp 
    WHERE from_date <= CURDATE() 
    GROUP BY dept_no, from_date 
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT dept_no, to_date AS event_date, -COUNT(*) AS delta 
    FROM dept_emp 
    WHERE to_date <= CURDATE() AND to_date <> '9999-01-01' 
    GROUP BY dept_no, to_date
), 
daily_changes AS (
    SELECT dept_no, event_date, SUM(delta) AS delta 
    FROM events 
    GROUP BY dept_no, event_date
) 
SELECT c.event_date, d.dept_name, 
       SUM(c.delta) OVER (PARTITION BY c.dept_no ORDER BY c.event_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS employee_count 
FROM daily_changes c 
JOIN departments d ON d.dept_no = c.dept_no 
ORDER BY c.event_date, d.dept_name;
```

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df['event_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['event_date'])
df['employee_count'] = pd.to_numeric(df['employee_count'])
df = df.sort_values(['dept_name', 'event_date'])
fig = px.line(df, x='event_date', y='employee_count', color='dept_name', line_shape='hv', title='Number of Employees per Department Over Time', labels={'event_date': 'Date', 'employee_count': 'Active employees', 'dept_name': 'Department'})
fig.update_layout(hovermode='x unified')
fig.show()
